title: Odd-even dichotomy in the waveforms of modified Emden oscillators of arbitrary integer power
summary: Closed-form waveforms of the modified Emden oscillators $\ddot x+(q+2)kx^q\dot x+k^2x^{2q+1}+ω^2x=0$ of arbitrary natural power $q$, and of their damped $c$-deformed versions, are obtained through a generalized commutative factorization that reduces them to Bernoulli equations. We show that commutative factorizations of Liénard equations are gauge-conjugated forms of the nonlocal linearizing transformation of Chandrasekar, Senthilvelan, Kundu and Lakshmanan, the factorization constant being half the difference of the roots of the associated linear oscillator.
